product_one_liner.value: Vectary is an online design platform for designers and creative teams to develop concepts with AI and create interactive 3D presentations and AR experiences for sharing.
product_one_liner.notes: Vectary’s homepage says its platform develops concepts with AI and creates interactive 3D presentations and AR experiences; its LinkedIn description identifies designers and creative teams as users.

pricing_page.notes: The public page is titled Pricing and lists plan labels including Pro AI and Business.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Vectary’s success stories identify Sharp, Dowina, and KTM as organizations that used or selected its platform. | named_customers.0: Vectary’s success story says Sharp integrated the Vectary platform into its 3D workflow. | named_customers.1: Vectary’s success story describes Dowina using its configurators. | named_customers.2: Vectary’s success story says KTM selected Vectary to create configurators.

employee_band.notes: The current LinkedIn company record gives an employee count of 18, which falls in the 11-20 band. Other directories have reported higher counts, so the exact count has some uncertainty.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Vectary’s LinkedIn company profile explicitly gives its headquarters as Redwood City, California. | hq_country: The Vectary LinkedIn profile identifies the country as the United States and its locality as Redwood City, California.

founded_year.notes: Vectary’s LinkedIn company profile states that it was founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The company’s blog index describes trend, news, resource, and inspiration content, categorizes entries as News, How to, Inspiration, Graphic Design, Web Design, and Augmented Reality, and highlights product-focused posts. It does not show an engineering blog or the required two posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Vectary’s public documentation index links to multiple product articles, image-to-3D instructions, tutorials, and API reference material.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Vectary careers listing says there are no open positions as of November 9, 2026, so no AI/ML role is open.

model_provider.value: Vectary names Hunyuan 3.1 and 3, Tripo H3.1 and 2.5, Pixal 3D, Trellis 2 and Trellis, Meshy 6 and 5, and Rodin 2 as models available for image-to-3D generation.
model_provider.notes: Vectary’s image-to-3D documentation says it supports a range of AI models and lists the named model families and versions.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Vectary’s security page names ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance and says it is SOC 2 certified; these are the listed qualifying names. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly states that Vectary is SOC 2 certified. | compliance_certs.1: The security page names ISO 27001 in its compliance statement. | compliance_certs.2: The security page names GDPR in its compliance statement.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: CB Insights labels the latest $4.6 million round, dated January 25, 2023, as Series A. | funding_date: The latest round is dated January 25, 2023, which normalizes to 2023-01. | funding_amount_usd: CB Insights identifies the latest funding as a $4.6 million Series A round.

raised_18mo.notes: The identified latest round was January 2023, before the 18-month period preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Vectary careers listing reports no open positions, so it is not hiring SDRs, BDRs, or account executives.

launched_6mo.notes: The Vectary Canvas Product Hunt launch page dates its launch to October 15, 2026, within six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile identifies a Vectary Chief Revenue Officer whose employment ended in May 2026, within the 12-month window before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Vectary’s readable integrations page lists productivity, web, presentation, creative, and communication tools, but names no CRM or sales/marketing system; therefore the requested list is empty.
